claims.claim: Feed expenses are the largest operating cost in cattle production, comprising about 75 percent of cow-calf operating costs in 2021 (USDA ERS).
claims.episode_span: Feed alone accounts for the largest share of variable cost
claims.source_title: Beef cattle producers face higher input costs, with feed prices up 16 percent since 2021 - USDA Economic Research Service
claims.supporting_quote: feed expenses are the largest operating cost for cow-calf producers, comprising 75 percent of these costs in 2021

claims.claim: Only a small fraction of feed dry matter becomes edible protein in ruminants: FAO estimates ruminants require about 133 kg of dry matter per kg of protein produced.
claims.episode_span: and only a fraction of that dry matter becomes edible protein
claims.supporting_quote: At global level, ruminants require 133 kg of dry matter per kg of protein while monogastrics require 30 kg.

claims.claim: The average nitrogen content of proteins is about 16 percent, consistent with the digest's rough figure of about 15 percent nitrogen.
claims.episode_span: about 50 percent carbon, 25 percent oxygen, 15 percent nitrogen, and smaller fractions of hydrogen and sulfur
claims.supporting_quote: on food labels the protein is calculated as the amount of nitrogen multiplied by 6.25, because the average nitrogen content of proteins is about 16%

claims.claim: World raw sugar (ISA daily price, f.o.b. Caribbean ports) traded between roughly $0.31 and $0.37 per kilogram from July 2025 to March 2026, consistent with the digest's $0.30-0.50/kg sugar feedstock figure.
claims.episode_span: Commodity glucose or sucrose supplies the carbon skeleton at roughly 0.30 to 0.50 dollars per kilogram
claims.source_title: Sugar - Monthly Price (US Dollars per Kilogram) - IndexMundi

claims.claim: Continuous perfusion culture is an established strategy for monoclonal antibody production in CHO cells, maintaining high cell density, product titer, and product quality.
claims.episode_span: pharmaceutical monoclonal-antibody plants already run continuous perfusion at far higher purity requirements
claims.source_title: Enhancing and stabilizing monoclonal antibody production by Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells with optimized perfusion culture strategies - PMC
claims.supporting_quote: The results indicated that continuous perfusion could maintain higher levels of cell density, product titer, and quality in comparison with those of the intermittent perfusion culture.
